title: Console
caption: A flexible desk with a screen slot and a seat anchor
intro: Compare two screens, the small desk, three mugs and custom content in one wide screen. The mirrored example marks where a seated Character belongs.
contract: Import Console and consoleLayout from slide-shared/deep-sea-expedition/console and console.pure. The origin is the desk top's front-left corner. Width changes the desk, not its height; children fill the first screen in its own coordinates. Place a seated Character at the returned seat anchor.
